categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Jet Bio-Filtration Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the life sciences consumables industry, focusing on the production and sales of biological laboratory consumables. Its main product categories include biological culture products, liquid handling products, and related instruments and consumables. The company serves both research and industrial customers, providing standardized products and customized solutions for biopharmaceutical research, cell and gene therapy, precision medicine, and related fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as polymer material modification (including plasma treatment for hydrophilic, superhydrophilic, and superhydrophobic surfaces), high-precision injection molding, high-precision extrusion, and 3D printing for cell culture devices. It also employs advanced manufacturing methods including automated assembly and sterilization outsourcing. The company has developed proprietary technologies in polymer surface modification and precision manufacturing, supporting a broad product portfolio with high biocompatibility and precision.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jet Bio-Filtration's primary customers include universities, research institutions, medical and health organizations, pharmaceutical and vaccine companies, and biotechnology firms. The products are used in life sciences research, biopharmaceutical development, cell and gene therapy, molecular diagnostics, and clinical applications. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a significant portion of sales to industrial clients requiring high-end, customized solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Guangzhou and has expanded its presence internationally through subsidiaries in the United States, Germany, and Hong Kong. Its products are exported to over 30 countries including the US, Germany, UK, Australia, India, Brazil, and Argentina. Overseas revenue accounts for approximately 66% of total sales, with significant market penetration in Europe, South America, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jet Bio-Filtration operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the life sciences supply chain. It manufactures and supplies laboratory consumables and production-grade tools essential for biopharmaceutical research and industrial cell culture processes. The company sources high-quality polymer raw materials, mostly imported, and integrates these into finished products for end users and OEM/ODM partners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in polymer material science, precision manufacturing, and intelligent automation. It focuses on developing products tailored for cell and gene therapy (CGT) and biopharmaceutical applications, including closed systems and modular production tools. R&D efforts emphasize domestic substitution of imported materials, smart manufacturing, and integrated solutions combining products, data, and services. The company also invests in building a multidisciplinary team and expanding global brand influence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of self-developed and manufactured biological consumables and related products. The company employs a mix of direct sales, distribution, and ODM (Original Design Manufacturing) contracts, especially for international clients. It also offers customized solutions and system integration services, with revenue derived from product sales and related service contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jet Bio-Filtration competes with global life sciences consumables giants such as Thermo Fisher, Corning, Merck KGaA, and regional specialized suppliers like Sarstedt and Eppendorf. Domestically, it is among the leading companies with a strong technological base and growing market share, especially in import substitution. The company is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise, positioning itself as a key player in China's life sciences consumables market with increasing international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 558.7 million, a 20.63% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 72.19 million, more than doubling from the previous year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.7 billion, with steady growth in net assets and a stable debt ratio of 29.67%. R&D investment accounted for 4.7% of revenue. The company has shown consistent revenue growth driven by increased sales of life sciences products, especially in overseas markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jet Bio-Filtration emphasizes its advanced polymer modification technologies and precision manufacturing capabilities to deliver high-quality, biocompatible, and reliable life sciences consumables. Its products offer superior performance in cell culture, filtration, and liquid handling, supporting cutting-edge biopharmaceutical and cell therapy applications. The company differentiates itself through integrated solutions, strong R&D, automated intelligent manufacturing, and a growing global brand presence, providing customers with cost-effective, innovative, and scalable products that meet stringent regulatory standards.
